entries.zh: 昏蒙；蠢钝无知（詈语：骂人如畜生、一无所知）
entries.en: brutish fool; worthless person who knows nothing (headword corrupt)
entries.notes: 词头残讹（ruid…nosabe 连写），H 栏「吞」与 R 栏 fum mun 对应不密合，疑为昏蒙／混沌之对音，释义依西语语境推断

entries.en: chopstick (per Chinese gloss; headword rueca = distaff, mismatched)
entries.notes: M 栏空白、R 栏仅存单音节 e；西语词头 Rueca（捻线杆）与「筷」不合，疑原稿词头串行，释义依汉字栏
词头 Rueca 带劃删号，与「筷仔」不合，疑词头串行；释义依汉字栏筷＋仔
词头 rueda 本指轮，汉字栏作车（车辆）；同行圈划另立「轮」字（第 5 条）

entries.en: the wheel of fortune; fate, destiny

entries.zh: 钻盘；旋盘（杆上所安旋转之轮盘）
entries.en: turning wheel/disc mounted on a pole (of the [baxma/basma], reading uncertain)
entries.notes: 词尾 baxma/basma 系存疑读法；R 栏 chui 与 H 栏钻对音待考，释义依汉字栏

entries.en: to ruminate, chew the cud (as cattle do)
noise of the voice; to make noise, clamor
noise of the voice; to din the ears
entries.notes: 词头尾词残缺（labo[残]ios），释义依汉字栏噪耳；R 栏 hy 疑为耳字对音

entries.zh: 浑响；水声轰响（对音疑作混沌）
entries.en: noise of the water; gurgling, rumbling
entries.notes: H 栏仅混字而 R 栏两音节 hun tun，疑原稿作混沌，与水声义合否未定，释义存疑

entries.en: noise of the water falling over a precipice; cascade
entries.notes: R 栏对音仅存疑形 tz/ti，H 栏消字与坠泻义不合，疑有讹字，释义依西语词头

entries.en: noise of a man shouting; clamor, confusion, tumult

entries.notes: 「嚷境」非习见词，境或为音借字；四栏于喧嚷骚动之义互证而成词可疑

entries.en: the noise a baby makes with its tongue while suckling; to smack one's lips
entries.notes: R 栏 hoa chhy 与弹口对音不密合，释义依汉字栏与西语释义（婴儿吮乳弹舌）
